'''Sergei Vladimirovich Konyagin''' ({{langx|ru|Серге́й Владимирович Конягин}}; born 25 April 1957)<ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=8491&option_lang=eng Info at MathNet.ru]</ref> is a Russian [[mathematician]]. He is a professor of mathematics at the [[Moscow State University]]. His primary research interest is in applying harmonic analysis to number theoretic settings.

Konyagin participated in the [[International Mathematical Olympiad]] for the [[Soviet Union]], winning two consecutive gold medals with perfect scores in 1972 and 1973. At the age of 15, he became one of the [[List of International Mathematical Olympiad participants#Exceptionally young participants|youngest people to achieve a perfect score]] at the IMO.

In 1990 Konyagin was awarded the [[Salem Prize]].

In 2012 he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |date=2018-08-25 }}, retrieved 2013-01-27.</ref>
